term: same-world fact occurrence with an actual concrete individual cause
definition: The SAME supplied fact f holds at v, and some c satisfies Concrete c, A.ontic.ExistsAt v c and the separate CauseFact v c f relation. CauseFact has type World→Being→Fact→Prop; it is not Arena.explains (fact→fact) or Ontic.Causes (individual→individual). The guard does not create a causal bearer or a fact.
note: Source-free typed profile over the unchanged PSRStrength.Arena and its Ontic. No source attribution or applicability is established. Existing fact/individual/world domains remain distinct; no fact is reified as a being. Intended reading: c partly or fully causally produces f’s obtaining, with both actually present in the represented complete history. A person closing a valve and the resulting no-flow condition illustrates individual-to-negative-fact orientation only; it does not establish a cause of an entire no-contingent-history situation. Mere co-occurrence, logical implication and an abstract fact-reason are excluded substitutes. No transitivity, asymmetry, priority, well-foundedness or necessitating sufficiency is assumed. Generalizing ordinary examples to the selected negative whole-history fact is OPEN. Rivals may reject causal relata of this kind, the concrete-bearer guard, or negative-fact causation; this theorem does not refute those interpretations.
